path: 上達のためのテクニック

intro.ja:
金無双への端攻めでは、角・桂・飛車と二枚以上の歩を協力させます。香で歩を取る受けと銀で取る受けでは、香を吊り上げて銀を狭める順や、角を切って銀を打つ順に分かれます。必要な持ち歩を数え、相手の最善の受けまで読みます。

角交換後は、飛車取りと守りの銀への攻めを兼ねる角打ちや、筋違い角で棒銀へ利きを足す構想があります。玉のコビンは継ぎ歩と垂れ歩で拠点を作り、銀と桂を交換して飛車を参加させる攻めが狙いです。攻めの形を目標に駒組みを進めます。
intro.en:
Edge attacks on Gold Fortress combine bishop, knight, rook, and multiple pawns. A lance capture and a silver capture lead to different plans: draw the lance forward to restrict the silver, or sacrifice the bishop and introduce a silver. Count the required pawns and calculate the defender’s best response rather than assuming the first tap must be accepted.

After bishop exchange, a bishop drop can attack the rook and defensive silver together, or add support to a Climbing Silver entry. The king’s diagonal weakness can be approached with successive and dangling pawns, followed by silver-and-knight exchanges and rook participation. Build toward these coordinated positions, checking the required pieces and pawn supply before selecting the plan.

question.ja: 端の歩を取る駒によって何が変わる？
question.en: What changes depending on who captures the edge pawn?

answer.ja: 香を狙う順か、角を切って銀を使う順かなど、続く攻め方が変わります。
answer.en: The continuation changes, including targeting the lance or sacrificing the bishop to introduce a silver.

courses.title: 金無双崩しの手筋: 図1-1 6六角からの金無双崩し → 図1-6 金無双を突破
courses.titleEn: Breaking Gold Fortress: Figure 1-1: Breaking Gold Fortress from the 6六 bishop → Figure 1-6: Gold Fortress broken through
courses.goalFormation:
図1-6 金無双を突破
△9四香と香車が逃げたところで、▲8一銀と桂馬を取りに行きます。そこから▲9三桂成と桂馬を成り、じわじわ攻めれば優勢です。手順は、▲9五歩、△同歩、▲9三歩、△同銀、▲同角成、△同香、▲9二銀、△8四角、▲8五桂、△9四香、▲8一銀、△同玉、▲9三桂成です。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

child.comment:
図1-6 金無双を突破
△9四香と香車が逃げたところで、▲8一銀と桂馬を取りに行きます。そこから▲9三桂成と桂馬を成り、じわじわ攻めれば優勢です。手順は、▲9五歩、△同歩、▲9三歩、△同銀、▲同角成、△同香、▲9二銀、△8四角、▲8五桂、△9四香、▲8一銀、△同玉、▲9三桂成です。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 1-6: Gold Fortress broken through
After the lance runs with △9四香, go after the knight with ▲8一銀. Then promoting the knight with ▲9三桂成 and pressing gradually leaves Black better. The line is ▲9五歩 △同歩 ▲9三歩 △同銀 ▲同角成 △同香 ▲9二銀 △8四角 ▲8五桂 △9四香 ▲8一銀 △同玉 ▲9三桂成.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

section.en: If captured with the silver

child.comment:
図1-5 後手は仕方なく角で受ける
後手はやむなく△8四角と受けますが、桂馬を跳ねて攻め駒を足します。せっかく取った角をこんなところに打つのはもったいないですが、後手にはこれが最善の受けです。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 1-5: White has to defend with the bishop
White reluctantly defends with △8四角, but Black adds an attacker by jumping the knight. It is a pity to use the captured bishop in such a spot, but this is White's best defense.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

section.en: If captured with the silver

child.comment:
図1-4 角を切って銀をぶち込む
角を切って△同香と取らせます。このとき△同桂なら、▲8四歩で桂馬が取れます。香車を吊り上げたら▲9二銀が狙いの一手で、次に▲8一銀、△同玉、▲8三飛成となれば金無双は崩壊します。角切りの後の▲9二銀が厳しい手です。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 1-4: Sacrifice the bishop and ram in the silver
Sacrifice the bishop and let White take with △同香. If White takes with △同桂 instead, ▲8四歩 wins the knight. After luring the lance up, ▲9二銀 is the key move, aiming for ▲8一銀 △同玉 ▲8三飛成, which collapses the Kinmusou. The ▲9二銀 after the bishop sacrifice is severe.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

section.en: If captured with the silver

child.comment:
図1-3 銀で取ってきた場合
まず銀で取ってきた場合を考えます。次の手は知らないと指せないかもしれません。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 1-3: If White captures with the silver
First consider the case where White captures with the silver. The next move may be hard to find unless you know it.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

section.en: If captured with the silver

child.comment:
図1-2 端から手を付ける
まず端の突き捨てから▲9三歩と打ちます。後手がこの9三の歩を取らないと、次に▲9五香と端を突破されます。ただし△9三桂とすると▲9四歩で桂馬が死ぬので、△9三銀か△9三香で歩を取りたいところです。端歩を捨てて▲9三歩と打ち込む手筋は、美濃囲いに対しても金無双に対しても有効です。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 1-2: Start from the edge
First, push and sacrifice the edge pawn and drop ▲9三歩. If White does not take this pawn, ▲9五香 breaks through the edge next. But △9三桂 loses the knight to ▲9四歩, so White wants to take the pawn with △9三銀 or △9三香. The tesuji of sacrificing the edge pawn and dropping ▲9三歩 works against both Mino and Kinmusou. Next we look at the cases where White takes with silver and with lance.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

section.ja: 向かい飛車&6六角型での崩し方
section.en: How to break through Opposing Rook with the ▲6六角 setup

root.comment:
図1-1 6六角からの金無双崩し
1つ目の手筋は、向かい飛車に構えて角が6六にいるときに使える手筋です。2枚の持ち歩と7七の桂馬もポイントです。これは基本の金無双崩しですが、手順が少し複雑なので頑張って覚えましょう。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
root.commentEn:
Figure 1-1: Breaking Gold Fortress from the 6六 bishop
The first tesuji is usable with an Opposing Rook setup when the bishop is on 6六. The two pawns in hand and the knight on 7七 are also key. It is the basic way to break a Kinmusou (double gold), but the sequence is slightly complex, so work to remember it.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

section.en: If captured with the lance

child.comment:
図1-9 相手の銀を動かす
後手は△9一銀と受けますが、構わず▲9二歩成とします。△同銀と取った後手の銀がかなり狭くなっているのがわかるでしょうか。もし▲9二歩と打てれば、相手の銀が取れます。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 1-9: Move the opponent's silver
White defends with △9一銀, but Black plays ▲9二歩成 regardless. Notice how cramped White's silver becomes after taking with △同銀. If Black can drop ▲9二歩, the silver can be captured.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

section.en: If captured with the lance

child.comment:
図1-8 香車を浮かせてさらに9三歩
桂馬で香車を狙い、浮いたところにさらに▲9三歩と打ちます。次の▲9二歩成は銀桂両取りになるので、後手は受けなければなりません。香車を吊り上げて裏側に歩を打つのです。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 1-8: Float the lance, then a pawn on 9三 as well
Aim the knight at the lance, and drop ▲9三歩 again where it floats. The next ▲9二歩成 would fork silver and knight, so White must defend. You keep luring the lance up and dropping pawns behind it.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

courses.goalFormation:
図3-2 露骨な角打ち
飛車と銀だけでは攻め駒が足りないので、▲5六角と打って駒の数を足します。狙いは露骨ですが、後手に適当な受けがなく、次の▲8四歩、△同歩、▲同銀からの攻めが分かっていても止められません。単純に8三に利きを足しているだけですが、後手には受ける手段がないのです。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

child.commentEn:
Figure 3-2: An obvious bishop drop
Rook and silver alone are not enough attackers, so add to the count by dropping ▲5六角. The aim is obvious, but White has no adequate defense and cannot stop the attack beginning ▲8四歩 △同歩 ▲同銀 even knowing it. It merely adds control to 8三, yet White has no way to meet it.

root.comment:

root.commentEn:
Figure 3-1: Break through with an off-file bishop drop
Next is a tesuji that breaks the castle by an off-line bishop drop. It is usable after a bishop exchange and is a common bishop use in Opposing Ranging Rook.

先手はここから▲8四歩、△同歩、▲同銀という攻めを狙います。図3-3では後手が△8三歩と受けても、駒の利きが1枚足りないため、そのまま▲8三銀成と攻められます。この手筋は角交換の相振り飛車でよく出ます。▲5六角打ちは相手が美濃でも金無双でも使え、無条件に角が打てればそれだけで優勢になります。

root.comment:

root.commentEn:
Figure 3-3: Climbing Silver succeeds
Black aims for the attack ▲8四歩 △同歩 ▲同銀. In Diagram 3-3, even if White defends with △8三歩, White is one piece short in control, so ▲8三銀成 attacks anyway. This tesuji often appears in Opposing Ranging Rook with a bishop exchange. The ▲5六角 drop works against either Mino or Kinmusou, and if the bishop can be dropped unconditionally, that alone gives an advantage.

section.ja: 玉のコビン(=ウサギの耳)を攻める
section.en: Attack the king's kobin (the rabbit ear)

root.comment:
図4-1 コビン攻めの基本図
最後は玉のコビン(ある駒の斜め上のマス)を攻める手筋です。石田流に組んでいて歩を3枚以上持っているときに使えます。金無双崩しとして最も有名ですが、実戦で歩を3枚以上持てることは少ないので使う機会は多くないかもしれません。しかし金無双のコビンは大きな弱点なので、応用の効きやすい手筋です。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。
root.commentEn:
Figure 4-1: Basic diagram of the kobin attack
Last is a tesuji attacking the king's kobin (the square diagonally above a piece). It is usable when you have built Ishida-style and hold three or more pawns. It is the most famous way to break a Kinmusou, though holding three pawns in a real game is rare, so chances to use it may be few. Still, the Kinmusou's kobin is a big weakness, so the tesuji is easy to adapt.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.
